blurb:
Experience one of America's most fascinating historical tours with a company recognized among the very best in the travel industry. We are proud to be a Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice Best of the Best winner for two consecutive years—Tripadvisor's highest honor, awarded only to businesses that consistently earn outstanding traveler reviews and rank among the top 1% of attractions and experiences worldwide. In addition, our company has been recognized as one of the Top 25 Best Tours in the United States, reflecting our commitment to providing exceptional sightseeing experiences.

This 2.5-hour small-group tour takes you deep into the events surrounding the assassination of President John F. Kennedy on November 22, 1963. Travel comfortably in an air-conditioned vehicle with an expert local guide as you follow the presidential motorcade route through downtown Dallas and visit the locations forever connected to that historic day.
Take memorable photos at each stop.
